[[Basketball Champions League|Champions League]] | team = Casademont Zaragoza | birth_date = {{birth date and age|df=yes|2000|6|19}} | birth_place = [[Strakonice]], Czech Republic | nationality = Czech | career_start = 2017 | years1 = 2017–present | team1 = [[Basket Zaragoza|Zaragoza]] | highlights = * [[ACB Best Young Player Award|ACB All-Young Players Team]] ([[2019–20 ACB season|2020]]) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|CZE}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA U20 European Championship#Division B|FIBA U20 European Championship B]]}} {{MedalSilver|[[2019 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B|2019 Portugal]]|[[Czech Republic men's national under-20 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Vít Krejčí''' (born 19 June 2000) is a Czech professional [[basketball]] player for [[Basket Zaragoza|Casademont Zaragoza]] of the [[Liga ACB]]. ==Early life and career== Krejčí was born in [[Strakonice]], Czech Republic and played basketball for the youth academy of Sokol Pisek.{{cite web |title=Vít Krejci: así lo ha hecho el base que empieza a despuntar en el Casademont Zaragoza |url=https://www.gigantes.com/liga-endesa/jovenes-promesas/vit-krejci-asi-lo-ha-hecho-el-base-que-empieza-a-despuntar-en-el-casademont-zaragoza-video/ |publisher=Gigantes del Basket |accessdate=27 June 2020 |language=Spanish |date=21 May 2020}} At age 14, he joined Spanish basketball club [[Basket Zaragoza|Zaragoza]]. In the 2016–17 season, he began playing for Anagan Olivar, the [[reserve team]] of Zaragoza, in the [[Liga EBA]].{{cite web |last1=Hein |first1=David |title=Krejci growing in confidence with Zaragoza and Czechs |url=http://www.championsleague.basketball/19-20/news/krejci-growing-in-confidence-with-zaragoza-and-czechs |publisher=[[Basketball Champions League]] |accessdate=27 June 2020 |date=26 March 2020}} ==Professional career== On 5 March 2017, at 16 years and eight months of age, Krejčí made his professional debut for Zaragoza against [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]]. He tied with [[Sergi García]] as the second-youngest debutant in club history, behind [[Carlos Alocén]]. On 17 April 2020, Krejčí declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Vit Krejci: Declares for draft |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/vit-krejci-declares-for-draft/ |publisher=CBS Sports |accessdate=27 June 2020 |date=17 April 2020}} In the 2019–20 season, Krejčí averaged 3.2 points in 9.2 minutes per game and was named to the [[ACB Best Young Player Award|ACB All-Young Players Team]].{{cite web |title=Mejor Quinteto Joven El Corte Inglés de la Liga Endesa 2019-20 |url=https://www.acb.com/articulo/ver/153499-mejor-quinteto-joven-el-corte-ingles-de-la-liga-endesa-201920.html |publisher=[[Liga ACB]] |accessdate=27 June 2020 |language=Spanish |date=25 June 2020}} On 25 September 2020, he suffered a season-ending left knee injury in a game against [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].{{cite web |last1=Askounis |first1=Johnny |title=Knee injury sidelines Vit Krejci for the remainder of the season |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1106090/knee-injury-sidelines-vit-krejci-for-the-remainder-of-the-season/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=27 September 2020 |date=27 September 2020}} ==National team career== Krejčí represented the Czech Republic on several occasions at the youth level. He was named to the All-Star Five of the [[2019 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]] in [[Matosinhos]], Portugal after averaging 14.9 points, 5.1 rebounds and 5.1 assists, leading his team to the silver medal. In February 2019, Krejčí made his debut for the [[Czech Republic men's national basketball team|senior national team]] during the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)|2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification]] stage. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.acb.com/jugador/temporada-a-temporada/id/20211133 Liga ACB profile] {{Basket Zaragoza current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Krejci, Vit}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basket Zaragoza players]] [[Category:Czech expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Czech men's basketball players]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:People from Strakonice]] [[Category:Point guards]]
